title: 上架感言：走个面儿！
content_zh:
上架感言：走个面儿！-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》
上一章

“咱新书收藏的爷们儿娘们儿，您受累，能不能给咱走个面儿？近一万的读者老爷，把第一波首订给带起来，带起来咱就有了！”
半个小时后更新！
时间像一头野驴，跑起来就不停！
上一本写了三百多万字，新书坎坎坷坷，也要上架了！
感谢编辑桔子，知遇之恩啊！上本书没人签约，在准备放弃写作的时候，跳出了签约站短，恨不得蹦起来。
这本呢，因为新的流量机制，我不是很懂，导致新书期非常焦虑。但是整体追读相对还是不错，上了三江，算是一个小成就。
“无君子，不养艺人！”你们就是我的衣食父母！感谢一直支持的老读者，感谢新加入的读者老爷，谢谢你们！
求个首订，顺便玩个梗！
谢谢各位读者老爷！除了感谢，好像也没其它的感言。
最后再祝大家开心快乐！
推一下朋友的书：《人生激荡四十年》，四百多万字的年代文。天赋型作者，因为没好看的书，决定自己写一本。第一本书两千九百均订，良师益友。
娱乐情报题材：精品文《混在模特圈，我的情报每日刷新》
缅北嘎腰子题材：《东南亚教父，从金山角收债开始》。作者外号快枪手，号称“出奇的快”。上架更新十万的狠人，自愧不如！
农场经营题材：《俄国农场：啤酒是怎样炼成的》。
最后是我的一个小扑街朋友，原谅我这么说，相识多年——《长生，从德鲁伊开始成仙》，加油，早日仙侠大成，屠神证道！
《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》上架感言：走个面儿！ 正在手打中，请稍等片刻，

"Men and women who collect our new books, if you are troubled, can you give us a try? Sir, the nearly 10,000 readers, please bring the first wave of first orders, and we will have it!"
Update in half an hour!
Time is like a wild donkey, it keeps running!
The last book was written with more than three million words, and the new book is about to be put on the shelves!
Thanks to editor Juzi, it’s a blessing! No one signed up for the last book. When I was about to give up writing, I jumped out of the signing website and wanted to jump up.
As for this book, I don’t understand the new traffic mechanism very well, which makes me very anxious about the new book period. But the overall pursuit of study is relatively good. Getting to Sanjiang is a small achievement.
"No gentleman, no artist!" You are my food, clothing, and parents! Thank you to the old readers who have always supported me, and to the new readers, thank you!
Please place an initial order and have fun with me!
Thank you readers! Apart from thanking you, I don’t seem to have any other words to say.
Finally, I wish you all happiness!
Recommend a friend's book: "Forty Years of Turbulence in Life", a chronicle of more than 4 million words. The talented author decided to write one because he had no good books. The first book was ordered by 2,900 people, and he was a good teacher and helpful friend.
Entertainment information theme: Excellent article "In the modeling circle, my information is refreshed every day"
The theme of Ga Yaozi in Northern Myanmar: "The Godfather of Southeast Asia, Starting from Debt Collection at Jinshanjiao". The author is nicknamed Kuaishou and is known as "surprisingly fast". The ruthless person who has updated hundreds of thousands of books is ashamed of himself!
Farm business theme: "Russian Farm: How Beer is Made".
Finally, there is a little street friend of mine, forgive me for saying so, we have known each other for many years - "Immortality, Becoming an Immortal from the Druid", come on, I will become an immortal as soon as possible and slay the gods to prove my truth!
